definition.name: Referral Marketing Platform
definition.overview:
A **Referral Marketing Platform** is a system used by a brand to run a customer referral program: it gives existing customers a personal, trackable way to recommend the brand, records which new customer arrived through which referrer, and grants the agreed rewards when a referral qualifies.

The defining structure is small:

```text
Referral program (configured incentives & eligibility, operated by the brand)
└── Advocate — an existing customer holding a personal trackable referral identity
    └── Share surface — the offer reaches people the advocate knows
        └── Referral attribution — the referred person's qualifying conversion
            is recorded as belonging to that advocate
            └── Reward — the program grants the configured incentive
```

Everything else commonly associated with the category — two-sided "give and get" offers, post-purchase popups, advocate portals, reward review periods, fraud detection, A/B testing, benchmarking — makes the program work in practice but is not what makes it a referral platform. Remove the personal trackable identity and the attribution, and what remains is an ordinary promotional discount. Remove the rewards, and it is a share-link gadget. Swap the participants from the brand's own customers to registered external partners, and it becomes an affiliate program.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**推荐营销平台**是品牌用于运营客户推荐计划的系统：它为现有客户提供一种个性化的、可追踪的方式来推荐该品牌，记录哪位新客户是通过哪位推荐人带来的，并在推荐符合条件时授予约定的奖励。

其定义性结构很小：

```text
推荐计划（配置好的激励与资格，由品牌运营）
└── 推荐者——持有个人可追踪推荐身份的现有客户
     └── 分享界面——优惠触达推荐者认识的人
         └── 推荐归因——被推荐人的合格转化
            被记录为归属于该推荐者
             └── 奖励——计划授予配置好的激励
```

通常与该类别相关联的其他所有内容——双向“给予与获得”优惠、购后弹窗、推荐者门户、奖励审核期、欺诈检测、A/B 测试、基准对比——使计划在实践中运作，但并非使其成为推荐平台的原因。移除个人可追踪身份和归因，剩下的就是普通的促销折扣。移除奖励，它就只是一个分享链接小工具。将参与者从品牌自己的客户换成注册的外部合作伙伴，它就变成了联盟计划。
definition.dc:
**Referral program.** The brand-configured container for the whole motion: what the advocate gets, what the friend gets, who is eligible, and under what conditions a referral qualifies for a reward. A brand may run one evergreen program or several campaigns aimed at different customer segments.

**Advocate.** An existing customer who participates in the program. Each advocate holds a **personal, trackable referral identity** — most commonly a unique referral link and/or a personal referral code. This identity is the hinge of the entire system: it is what makes an otherwise private recommendation attributable.

**Referred friend and the qualifying action.** A person who arrives through an advocate and performs the action the program rewards — typically a first purchase, a signup, a booking, or (in service and B2B businesses) a milestone in the sales pipeline such as a closed deal or a completed job.

**Referral attribution.** The recorded connection between the friend's conversion and the advocate who caused it. Attribution is the platform's central bookkeeping act: every conversion it accepts becomes a referral record naming the advocate, the friend, the qualifying action, and the reward state.

**Reward.** The incentive granted when a referral qualifies. Rewards attach to the *arrival of another person*, which distinguishes them from loyalty rewards (attached to one's own repeat purchases). Both sides can be rewarded — a reward for the advocate and an offer for the friend — which is the category's most common shape, but one-sided programs (rewarding only the referrer, or only the friend) are fully supported program designs.
definition.dc_zh:
**推荐计划。** 品牌配置的整个推荐活动的容器：包括推荐人获得什么，朋友获得什么，谁有资格，以及在什么条件下推荐有资格获得奖励。品牌可能运行一个常青计划或针对不同客户细分的多个活动。

**推荐人。** 参与该计划的现有客户。每个推荐人都持有一个**个人可追踪的推荐身份**——最常见的是一条唯一的推荐链接和/或一个个人推荐码。这个身份是整个系统的枢纽：它使得原本私人的推荐变得可归属。

**被推荐的朋友和合格行动。** 通过推荐人到来并执行计划奖励的行动的人——通常是首次购买、注册、预订，或（在服务和B2B业务中）销售管道中的里程碑，如成交或完成工作。

**推荐归因。** 朋友转化与导致它的推荐人之间的记录连接。归因是平台的核心记账行为：它接受的每一次转化都成为一个推荐记录，命名推荐人、朋友、合格行动和奖励状态。

**奖励。** 当推荐合格时授予的激励。奖励与*另一个人的到来*挂钩，这使其与忠诚奖励（与自身的重复行为挂钩）区分开来。
definition.rules:
### Attribution is the system of record

The value of the platform is that every reward traces back to a specific, attributed referral. Manual correction (marking, approving, disqualifying) exists precisely because automatic attribution — cookies, codes, name matching — is imperfect.

### Rewards are gated, not instant

Qualification comes before fulfillment. Review windows, eligibility conditions, and fraud checks sit between the friend's conversion and the advocate's reward. Refunded or cancelled purchases typically disqualify their referrals; a referral made while the program is paused is usually not rewardable.

### The referred person must normally be new

Programs exist to acquire customers. The common eligibility rule is that an existing customer does not count as a referral — which makes the platform's customer identity data (from the connected store or CRM) part of the reward logic.

### Program state controls behavior

A live program enrolls, tracks, and rewards. Pausing usually stops new enrollment and blocks new rewardable referrals while honoring rewards already in flight. Because many mechanics are automated (offer codes, integrated billing), platforms may stop a program automatically when something it depends on breaks.

### Fraud economics shape the design

Because rewards are money, the platform treats abuse as a first-class concern: self-referrals, duplicate identities, leaked coupon codes, and abnormal referral spikes are detected and blocked before payout, and advocates can be banned. Fraud controls are why the qualification gate exists at all.

### Rewards and payouts carry real-world obligations

Cash rewards and payouts create accounting and tax responsibilities for the brand (for example, reporting payouts to individuals), which is why many products manage reward invoices, payout exports, or third-party payment integrations rather than moving money invisibly.
definition.rules_zh:
### 归因是记录系统

平台的价值在于每个奖励都可以追溯到特定的、已归因的推荐。手动纠正（标记、批准、取消资格）的存在正是因为自动归因——cookie、代码、名称匹配——是不完美的。

### 奖励是受控的，而非即时的

资格确认先于履行。审核窗口、资格条件和欺诈检查位于朋友的转化和推荐者的奖励之间。退款或取消的购买通常取消其推荐的资格；在计划暂停期间做出的推荐通常不可奖励。

### 被推荐人通常必须是新的

计划的存在是为了获取客户。常见的资格规则是现有客户不算作推荐——这使得平台的客户身份数据（来自连接的商店或 CRM）成为奖励逻辑的一部分。

### 计划状态控制行为

在线计划注册、追踪和奖励。暂停通常停止新注册并阻止新的可奖励推荐，同时履行已在途的奖励。由于许多机制是自动化的（优惠码、集成计费），当依赖项失效时，平台可能会自动停止计划。

### 欺诈经济学塑造设计

因为奖励是金钱，平台将滥用视为首要关注点：自我推荐、重复身份、泄露的优惠券代码和异常的推荐激增在支付前被检测和阻止，推荐者可能被禁止。欺诈控制是资格门存在的原因。

### 奖励和支付带来现实世界的义务

现金奖励和支付为品牌带来会计和税务责任（例如，向个人报告支付），这就是许多产品

definition.name: Contact Discovery Platform
definition.overview:
A **Contact Discovery Platform** is a sourcing application whose job is to produce contact records an organization does not yet have. The user states who to find — as a set of criteria or as a specific identity — and the platform's external data supply of business people (and commonly companies) yields matching records with verified reachability data: work emails, direct-dial phone numbers, titles, employers, locations. The records are then taken away into the user's own tools — a CRM, an ATS, a spreadsheet, an outreach campaign.

The defining core is small:

```text
External supply of business contact records the customer does not own
└── Sourcing act: criteria- or identity-driven yield of net-new records
    └── Record set with verified reachability data as the deliverable
        └── Taken away into the customer's own tools
```

Everything else commonly associated with these products — fifty-filter search consoles, credit systems, browser extensions, intent signals, AI assistants, compliance certifications — is standard mature machinery or a variant posture, not what makes the product a contact discovery platform.

The boundary is deliberate: a contact discovery platform does not complete records the customer already holds (that is data enrichment), does not run the outreach that follows (that is prospecting workflow and sales engagement), and does not deliver selling decisions about whom to pursue and when (that is sales intelligence). It ends where the sourced records change hands.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**联系人发现平台**是一种寻源应用，其职责是生成组织尚未拥有的联系人记录。用户指明要寻找的对象——作为一组标准或一个特定身份——而平台的外部商业人士（通常也包括公司）数据供给则产出匹配的、带有已验证可达性数据的记录：工作邮箱、直拨电话号码、职位、雇主、地点。随后，这些记录被转移至用户自己的工具中——一个CRM、一个ATS、一个电子表格或一个外展活动。

其定义性核心很小：

```text
客户不拥有的外部商业联系人记录供给
└── 寻源行为：基于标准或身份驱动，产出净新增记录
     └── 以带有已验证可达性数据的记录集作为交付物
         └── 转移至客户自己的工具中
```

通常与这些产品相关联的其他一切——五十种过滤器的搜索控制台、积分系统、浏览器扩展、意向信号、AI助手、合规认证——都是标准的成熟机制或一种变体姿态，而非使该产品成为联系人发现平台的原因。

边界是刻意划定的：联系人发现平台不补全客户已持有的记录（那是数据增强），不运行随后的外展（那是寻源工作流和销售互动），也不提供关于追求谁及何时追求的销售决策（那是销售情报）。它在寻源记录发生交接的地方结束。
definition.dc:
**2. The sourcing act as the primary job.**
The customer expresses who to find, and the platform produces matching records the customer did not previously hold. The expression takes several documented forms:

- **criteria-driven search** — attribute filters (role, seniority, geography, industry, company size, technology, funding) applied against the supply
- **identity-driven lookup** — a specific person sought by name and company, or by a profile URL
- **in-context capture** — a browser extension that reveals and saves a record while the user browses a professional network or company site
- **list import** — uploading identities (profile URLs, company URLs, emails) for the platform to resolve into records
- **expansion and AI-directed sourcing** — lookalike seeds from existing good records, or natural-language descriptions turned into searches

The direction matters: records flow *from the market to the customer*. This is the opposite loop from enrichment, which starts from records the customer holds and completes them.

**3. The yielded record set as the unit of value, delivered out.**
The deliverable is the records themselves — with contact details attached — exported, synced, or pushed into the customer's own tools: CSV downloads, CRM sync, ATS delivery, outreach-tool handoff, API responses. The platform does not run the outreach, own the resulting relationships, or rank what to do next. A sourced record set is transient by nature: once taken away, its life continues in the customer's systems.
definition.dc_zh:
2. 寻找行为作为主要工作。

客户表达要找谁，平台生成客户先前没有的匹配记录。表达形式有多种记录形式：

- 基于标准的搜索 — 应用于供应侧的属性过滤器（角色、资历、地理位置、行业、公司规模、技术、融资）
- 基于身份的查找 — 通过姓名和公司或个人资料URL查找特定人员
- 上下文捕获 — 浏览器扩展，在用户浏览专业网络或公司网站时揭示并保存记录
- 列表导入 — 上传身份（个人资料URL、公司URL、电子邮件）让平台解析成记录
- 扩展和AI指导的寻找 — 从现有好记录中提取相似种子，或将自然语言描述转化为搜索

方向很重要：记录从市场流向客户。这与充实相反，充实从客户已有的记录开始并补全它们。

3. 生成的记录集作为价值单位，交付出去。

交付物是记录本身——附有联系详情——导出、同步或推送到客户自己的工具中：CSV下载、CRM同步、ATS交付、外展工具交接、API响应。平台不运行外展、不拥有由此产生的关系，也不排名
definition.rules:
### The yield is metered; the search is not

Across the researched sample, browsing and filtering are typically unmetered while contact-data retrieval consumes credits — and several products explicitly do not charge when no valid contact data is found. The economic unit is the yielded record, not the query.

### Net-new is enforced, not just intended

Discovery products carry machinery that keeps results net-new: excluding previously downloaded records (in one sampled product by default), excluding CRM-synced contacts, uploaded exclusion lists, and suppression-list filtering. Without this, the same records would be re-sourced and re-charged.

### A record can exist before its contact data

Capture-without-data is a documented pattern: a record saved from a profile URL with no email attached, to be completed later. The record and its reachability data are separable layers.

### Verification gates delivery

Contact data is verified at reveal or at export, with states or grades exposed to the user; accuracy guarantees with credit refunds are the commercial expression of the same discipline. Reachability data decays as people change jobs, so refresh and reverification are structural concerns.

### Compliance shapes the supply

Regional exclusion toggles (excluding an entire economic area's records), suppression and opt-out support, and professional-use scoping are structural: they determine which records can be sourced and delivered at all, not just how the product is marketed.

### The platform ends at the handoff

Once records are delivered, the platform's job is done. It does not run the sequences, own the relationships, or decide what to do next — neighboring Types own those jobs.
definition.rules_zh:
### 产出被计量；搜索不被计量

在研究的样本中，浏览和过滤通常不被计量，而联系人数据检索消耗积分——并且多个产品明确规定，当未找到有效联系人数据时不收费。经济单位是产出的记录，而非查询。

### 净新增被强制执行，而不仅仅是意图

发现产品携带保持结果净新增的机制：排除先前下载的记录（在一个被抽样产品中默认排除）、排除CRM同步的联系人、上传的排除列表以及抑制列表过滤。没有这些，相同的记录将被重新寻源并重新收费。

### 记录可以在其联系人数据之前存在

无数据捕获是一个有记录的模式：从一个个人资料URL保存的记录，未附带邮箱，以便稍后补全。记录及其可达性数据是可分离的层。

### 验证门控交付

联系人数据在揭示时或导出时被验证，状态或等级向用户暴露；带有积分退款的准确性保证是同一纪律的商业表达。随着人们更换工作，可达性数据会衰减，因此刷新和重新验证是结构性问题。

### 合规塑造供给

区域排除开关（排除整个经济区域的记录）、抑制和退出支持以及专业使用范围是结构性的：它们决定哪些记录可以被寻源和交付，而不仅仅是产品如何营销。

### 平台在交接处结束

一旦记录被交付，平台的职责就完成了。它不运行序列，不拥有关系，也不决定下一步做什么——相邻的类型拥有这些职责。

definition.name: Lead Management Platform
definition.overview:
A **Lead Management Platform** is a selling organization's system of record for its **pre-customer prospect population** — the people and organizations that have shown interest or been identified as prospects, from the moment they enter the pipeline until they are qualified and handed off to the selling machinery, or set aside as not ready.

Its defining structure is small:

```text
Lead population of record
└── Qualification-and-disposition lifecycle
    ├── conversion → contact / account / deal records (the downstream seam)
    └── disqualification / recycling
└── Distribution-and-working machinery
    (assignment, routing, follow-up, response-time discipline)
```

Everything commonly associated with lead management — lead scoring, rule-based routing engines, instant-response automation, multi-source capture, nurture cadences, AI qualification — is widespread in current products but is not what makes the product a lead management platform. A paper-era inquiry card file, distributed by a sales manager to reps with follow-up dates and status dividers, satisfies the same core.

When the center of gravity shifts to the full customer relationship after conversion, the product is a CRM; when it shifts to the qualified deal after qualification, it is pipeline management; when it shifts to producing and supplying leads, it is lead generation or lead capture.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**线索管理平台**是销售组织用于记录其**潜在客户群体**的系统——即那些已表现出兴趣或被识别为潜在客户的人员和组织，从他们进入销售漏斗的那一刻起，直到他们被资格认定并移交给销售执行体系，或被搁置为尚未准备好。

其定义性结构很小：

```text
线索记录群体
└── 资格认定与处置生命周期
     ├── 转化 → 联系人 / 客户 / 商机记录（下游接缝）
     └── 不合格 / 回收
└── 分配与处理机制
     （分配、路由、跟进、响应时间纪律）
```

通常与线索管理相关的一切——线索评分、基于规则的路由引擎、即时响应自动化、多源捕获、培育节奏、AI 资格认定——在当前产品中普遍存在，但这并不是使该产品成为线索管理平台的原因。一个纸质时代的咨询卡片档案，由销售经理分配给销售代表并附带跟进日期和状态分隔符，同样满足这一核心需求。

当重心转移到转化后的完整客户关系时，该产品是 CRM；当重心转移到资格认定后的合格商机时，它是销售漏斗管理；当重心转移到产生和供应线索时，它是线索生成或线索捕获。
definition.dc:
- **lead scoring** — manual rule models or AI/predictive scoring to prioritize who gets worked first
- **routing engines** — round-robin, criteria/territory matching, workload and availability weighting, automatic reassignment when response-time commitments are at risk
- **speed-to-lead automation** — instant acknowledgment (auto text/email on capture), claim-based assignment, escalation of untouched leads to managers
- **multi-source capture aggregation** — leads from web forms, ads, portals, aggregators, calls, and imports consolidated into the one population
- **duplicate detection and merge** — the same prospect arriving from several sources becomes one lead
- **cadences and nurture coordination** — drip sequences and long-horizon nurtures for leads not ready yet
- **population monitoring** — funnel and conversion by stage, conversion by source, time-in-stage, response-time metrics, stalled-lead flags
- **consent and privacy machinery** — recording and managing prospect consent
definition.dc_zh:
- **潜客评分** — 手动规则模型或AI/预测性评分，以优先处理目标客户
- **路由引擎** — 循环分配、条件/区域匹配、工作量与可用性加权，在响应时间承诺面临风险时自动重分配
- **响应速度自动化** — 即时确认（录入时自动短信/邮件）、认领式分配、对未处理线索的经理级升级
- **多源采集聚合** — 将来自网页表单、广告、门户、聚合商、电话和导入的线索整合到统一客户池
- **重复检测与合并** — 同一潜在客户从不同渠道进入时合并为单一线索
- **培育序列协调** — 针对未成熟潜客的渐进式推送与长期培育流程
- **客户池监控** — 漏斗各阶段转化率、来源转化率、阶段停留时长、响应时间指标、线索停滞预警
- **同意授权机制** — 记录与管理潜在客户的授权同意状态
definition.rules:
### The lead leaves the population at disposition

Conversion moves the lead out of the lead population and into the relationship/deal records; in dedicated-lead-object products this is a one-way act — the lead cannot simply be reverted. Disqualified leads, by contrast, typically remain in the population (as lost or nurture records) rather than being deleted.

### Assignment divides the inflow

The population is worked through ownership: each lead has (or awaits) an owner responsible for working it. Shared unassigned pools are a legitimate state — leads wait there to be claimed — but a lead that no one ever claims is a management failure the system surfaces.

### Response time is a first-class discipline

New leads are expected to be contacted quickly; the system records, reminds, escalates, and reports on the interval. This is a defining behavioral emphasis of the Type, not a cosmetic feature.

### Source attribution travels with the lead

Where a lead came from is recorded on the lead and carried into conversion, because conversion-by-source is one of the population's key managed outcomes.

### Duplicate control is continuous

The same prospect arriving from multiple sources is merged, not multiplied — at intake, during working, and again at conversion (where the new contact is matched against existing records).

### Qualification is the organization's judgment, not the system's

Stages, statuses, and qualification criteria are configured by each organization; the system enforces the lifecycle, not the vocabulary.
definition.rules_zh:
### 线索在处置时离开群体

转化将线索移出线索群体并进入关系/商机记录；在专用线索对象产品中，这是一个单向操作——线索不能简单地回退。相比之下，不合格线索通常保留在群体中（作为流失或培育记录）而不是被删除。

### 分配划分流入

群体通过所有权进行处理：每条线索都有（或等待）一个负责处理它的负责人。共享的未分配池是一个合法状态——线索在那里等待被认领——但一条从未被任何人认领的线索是系统揭示的管理失败。

### 响应时间是一级纪律

新线索预计被快速联系；系统记录、提醒、升级并报告该间隔。这是该类型定义性的行为重点，而非表面特征。

### 来源归属随线索移动

线索来源记录在线索上并带入转化，因为按来源的转化率是群体关键管理成果之一。

### 重复控制是连续的

同一潜在客户从多个来源到达时是合并而非倍增——在接收时、在处理期间以及在转化时（新联系人与现有记录匹配）。

### 资格认定是组织的判断，而非系统的

阶段、状态和资格认定标准由每个组织配置；系统执行生命周期，而非词汇表。

definition.name: Outreach Sequencing Platform
aliases_zh: 多渠道自动化外展系统
definition.overview:
An **Outreach Sequencing Platform** is a sales execution application in which a sales team defines a repeatable, multi-touch outreach program — a **sequence** of steps across channels such as email, calls, and social touches, separated by waiting periods — and enrolls individual prospects into it. The system then carries the program out: it sends the email steps automatically on schedule, surfaces the human steps (calls, social touches, notes) as tasks for the rep, tracks where each prospect is in the flow, and changes or halts that prospect's progression when the prospect responds — a reply stops the sequence, a bounced email excludes the prospect from further email steps, an opt-out removes them.

The defining structure is small:

```text
Prospect (identified person with a reachable channel)
└── enrolled into
    Sequence (ordered steps + waits, defined once, reused for many prospects)
        └── per-prospect progression state
            ├── system-executed touches (automatic email sends)
            ├── rep-executed touches (call / social / note tasks)
            └── response events that interrupt or redirect the flow
                (reply → stop · bounce → exclude · opt-out → remove)
```

Everything else commonly associated with these products — template libraries, deliverability tooling, unified inboxes, AI drafting, dialers, CRM sync, analytics — is standard equipment that makes the core practical, but the product remains recognizable as this Type without any of it. The Type spans a scope gradient: from standalone email-first sequencers used by small teams, up to enterprise sales engagement platforms where the same sequencing machinery is the core of a much broader revenue suite.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**外展序列平台**是一种销售执行应用程序，销售团队在其中定义一个可重复的多触点外展计划——即一个**序列**，包含跨电子邮件、电话和社交触达等渠道的步骤，步骤之间设有等待期——并将单个潜在客户纳入其中。随后系统执行该计划：它按计划自动发送电子邮件步骤，将人工步骤（电话、社交触达、备注）作为任务呈现给销售代表，追踪每个潜在客户在流程中的位置，并在潜在客户做出响应时更改或停止该潜在客户的进展——回复会停止序列，退信会将潜在客户排除在后续电子邮件步骤之外，退订则将其移除。

其定义性结构很小：

```text
Prospect (identified person with a reachable channel)
└── enrolled into
    Sequence (ordered steps + waits, defined once, reused for many prospects)
         └── per-prospect progression state
             ├── system-executed touches (automatic email sends)
             ├── rep-executed touches (call / social / note tasks)
             └── response events that interrupt or redirect the flow
                 (reply → stop · bounce → exclude · opt-out → remove)
```

通常与这些产品相关联的其他所有内容——模板库、送达率工具、统一收件箱、AI 起草、拨号器、CRM 同步、分析——都是使核心实用的标准配置，但即使没有这些，该产品仍可被识别为此**类型**。该**类型**跨越一个范围梯度：从小团队使用的独立电子邮件优先序列器，到企业级销售参与平台，在后者中，相同的序列机制是更广泛收入套件的核心。
definition.dc_zh:
**潜在客户记录。** 工作单位是一个已识别的人——姓名、电子邮件地址，以及通常包括公司、职位和电话。潜在客户不仅仅是邮件列表中的一行：系统为每个潜在客户维护一个状态，记录该潜在客户正在等待的步骤、已发送的内容以及他们的响应方式。

**序列。** 序列是一个可重复使用的程序：一个有序的步骤链，连续步骤之间有等待（延迟）。每个步骤指定一个渠道和一个行动——发送电子邮件（通常使用模板）、拨打电话、执行LinkedIn操作、发送短信或完成一个通用任务。同一个序列为每个注册的潜在客户独立执行，因此一个定义驱动数百个并行的、单独跟踪的外展流程。成熟的产品还允许条件分支——一个步骤或等待取决于潜在客户在上一步的行为（打开、点击、回复、接受连接）——因此程序会根据每个潜在客户进行调整，而不是作为一条刚性线路运行。

**注册。** 将潜在客户放入序列中会创建一个具有自身状态的每个潜在客户实例：活跃、等待步骤N、暂停、完成、弹回、选择退出、外出办公。注册可以手动进行（选择联系人并添加）、批量进行（导入列表）、按计划进行（开始日期）或自动进行（触发器或CRM同步在满足条件时添加潜在客户）。
definition.rules:
- **A reply ends the automated flow.** When a prospect replies, the sequence stops for that prospect automatically — the conversation has become human, and further automated touches would be wrong. This behavior is documented explicitly in products that describe their sequencing mechanics, and the reply lands in the product's inbox for the rep to continue.
- **Bounces protect the future.** A bounced email both excludes that prospect from subsequent email steps and counts against the sender's reputation; products monitor bounce rates and will slow down, suspend, or auto-stop sending when thresholds are exceeded.
- **Opt-out is absolute.** An unsubscribe removes the prospect from outreach regardless of sequence state; products expose opt-out management as a first-class list.
- **Human steps block progression.** A sequence containing a call or task step waits for the rep to complete it before that prospect advances — the rep's action is part of the program's timeline, not an aside to it.
- **Delays respect the sending calendar.** Waits between steps are typically counted against configured sending days/hours, so a "one-day delay" that crosses a weekend or a disabled day lands on the next eligible sending day. Time-zone handling for recipients is a common configuration concern.
- **Sending is throttled.** Daily limits act as caps shared across a sender's campaigns; pacing controls spread sends over the day. Products treat these as protective (deliverability) rather than as targets, and some algorithmic throttling cannot be overridden by the user.
- **Active sequences resist structural edits.** Because prospects are mid-flight, products commonly restrict reordering or replacing steps in a running sequence (or apply changes only to prospects that have not yet reached the affected step); per-prospect skip/pause remains available.
- **One prospect, possibly many sequences.** Products differ on whether a prospect may sit in several sequences at once; where allowed, this is the rep's judgment call, and duplicate-contact handling is a known operational hazard.
- **Out-of-office is a pause, not an end.** OOO replies typically pause the prospect automatically and resume later (on a configured delay or by hand), since the absence is temporary.
- **Consent and anti-spam constraints shape design.** Opt-out links, plain-text options, authentication, and warm-up exist because the product sends 1:1 sales email at volume from personal domains — a context with real deliverability and legal exposure.
definition.rules_zh:
- **回复终止自动化流程。** 当潜在客户回复时，该潜在客户的序列会自动停止——对话已变为人工，进一步的自动化触达将是错误的。这一行为在描述其序列机制的产品中被明确记录，且回复会进入产品的收件箱供销售代表继续处理。
- **退信保护未来。** 退信既将该潜在客户排除在后续电子邮件步骤之外，又计入发送者的声誉；产品监控退信率，并在超过阈值时减速、暂停或自动停止发送。
- **退订是绝对的。** 取消订阅会将潜在客户从外展中移除，无论序列状态如何；产品将退订管理作为一级列表暴露。
- **人工步骤阻塞进展。** 包含电话或任务步骤的序列会等待销售代表完成该步骤后，该潜在客户才会推进——销售代表的操作是计划时间线的一部分，而非旁支。
- **延迟尊重发送日历。** 步骤之间的等待通常按配置的发送日/小时计算，因此跨越周末或禁用日的“一天延迟”会落在下一个符合条件的发送日。收件人的时区处理是常见的配置关注点。
- **发送受到节流。** 每日限制作为跨发送者活动的共享上限；节奏控制将发送分散到全天。产品将这些视为保护性（送达率）而非目标，且某些算法节流无法被用户覆盖。
- **活动序列抵制结构性编辑。** 由于潜在客户处于进行中，产品通常限制对运行中序列的步骤重新排序或替换（或仅将更改应用于尚未到达受影响步骤的潜在客户）。

definition.name: Sales Dialer
definition.overview:
A **Sales Dialer** is the individual seller's outbound-calling workstation: software through which a seller personally places outbound sales calls against a managed set of prospect records, sees each record's context during the live call, and has the outcome of every call captured back onto that record.

Its reason to exist is that outbound calling is repetitive, context-poor, and admin-heavy when done from a plain phone: the seller must find who to call next, remember who they are, dial by hand, and then record what happened somewhere else. A sales dialer collapses all of that into one record-driven calling loop — the list tells the seller who is next, the record tells them who they reached, and the system does the logging.

The boundary is individual-rep outbound calling. Team-scale inbound/outbound call distribution (queues, agent states, campaign pacing machinery) belongs to call-center software; multi-touch outreach programs in which a call is only one step type belong to sales engagement platforms; a general-purpose phone endpoint with no record binding is a softphone. A sales dialer may sit inside any of those host products, but the calling surface itself keeps the posture described here.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**销售拨号器**是单个销售人员的出站呼叫工作站：销售人员通过该软件针对一组管理好的潜在客户记录亲自发起出站销售呼叫，在通话过程中查看每条记录的上下文，并将每次呼叫的结果记录回该记录中。

其存在的理由是，当使用普通电话进行出站呼叫时，该过程具有重复性、上下文匮乏且行政负担重的特点：销售人员必须查找下一个要呼叫的对象，记住对方是谁，手动拨号，然后在其他地方记录发生了什么。销售拨号器将所有这些步骤整合为一个由记录驱动的呼叫循环——列表告诉销售人员下一个是谁，记录告诉他们联系上了谁，而系统负责记录日志。

其边界在于单个销售代表的出站呼叫。团队规模的入站/出站呼叫分配（队列、坐席状态、活动节奏机制）属于呼叫中心软件；呼叫仅为其中一个步骤类型的多触点外展项目属于销售参与平台；没有记录绑定的通用电话终端则是软电话。销售拨号器可以位于上述任何宿主产品中，但呼叫界面本身保持此处描述的姿态。
definition.dc:
```text
Individual seller
└── Managed prospect records (the record store the calls are made against)
    └── Call list / queue drawn from those records
        └── Live outbound call placed against a record
            └── Call outcome captured back onto the record
```

Four structures. If any one is removed, the product stops being a sales dialer:

- **The individual seller as caller.** Calls are placed and conducted by a named seller as their own work — not pulled from a queue and routed to whoever is available. The rep's personal productivity is what the product optimizes.
- **Prospect records as the substance of calling.** The call is made *against a record* — a lead, contact, or task that carries the phone numbers, the context of prior touches, and the relationship. The record supplies both the call list and the per-call context. Calling is record-bound, never blind dialing as the primary flow.
- **The live outbound call as the unit of work.** The center of the product is the live conversation, with its connected-time mechanics: getting the call placed, handling what happens (live answer, voicemail, no answer), and moving on. Everything else in the product exists to increase the number and quality of these live conversations.
- **Outcome capture.** Every call leaves a record of itself — an outcome classification, notes, and (where enabled) a recording and transcript — attached to the prospect record and visible in the seller's workflow. Without the write-back, calling stays disconnected from the sales process.
definition.dc_zh:
个人销售员
└── 管理的潜在客户记录（记录存储通话所针对的数据）
    └── 从这些记录中提取的呼叫列表/队列
        └── 针对记录进行的实时外呼
            └── 通话结果被捕获并回写到记录

四个结构，如果移除任何一个，产品就不再是销售拨号器：

- **个人销售员作为呼叫者。** 通话由指定的销售员作为自己的工作进行和发起——而不是从队列中拉取并路由给任何可用的人。产品的优化目标是代表个人的生产力。

- **潜在客户记录作为呼叫的实质。** 通话是*针对记录*进行的——一个潜在客户、联系人或任务，包含电话号码、先前互动上下文和关系。记录提供呼叫列表和每次呼叫的上下文。呼叫是记录绑定的，主要流程中从不进行盲拨。

- **实时外呼作为工作单位。** 产品的中心是实时对话，及其连接时间机制：发起通话、处理发生的情况（实时应答、语音信箱、无应答），然后继续。产品中的其他一切都是为了增加这些实时对话的数量和质量。

- **结果捕获。** 每次通话都留下自己的记录——结果分类、笔记，以及（在启用时）录音和转录——
definition.rules:
### The record decides what gets dialed

Automated dialing works on the record's stored phone details; manual work-arounds to dial secondary numbers or repeat attempts are limited in many products. The record binding is therefore also a constraint on the calling itself.

### Disposition closes the call

A call is not "done" until its outcome is classified. Dispositions feed reporting, filtering, and follow-up generation; some products require a follow-up date before a follow-up disposition can be saved. Call outcomes are among the most-filtered data in the sales workflow.

### Logging is automatic and near-immediate

The system records the call as it happens; the seller's job is the conversation and the classification, not data entry. Manual logging exists as a fallback for calls placed outside the system — a deliberate acknowledgment that the record store must reflect reality even when the call didn't run through the dialer.

### Caller identity is an operating concern, not a setting

Outbound reach depends on the numbers used: presenting local or recognized numbers, rotating or monitoring them, and remediating spam mislabels is ongoing operational work that the product surfaces to its users. Caller-ID verification policies and spam-label protection are standard parts of the machinery.

### Compliance behaviors are built in at a light depth

Compliance features appear in a lighter form than in call-center systems: some products check numbers against do-not-call registries and internal suppression lists, some restrict calling to defined time windows, and recording consent is handled with jurisdiction-sensitive defaults (recording can usually be paused mid-call). Automated team-scale dialing modes typically include abandonment handling, such as a recorded message played when a prospect answers with no seller available. Heavier campaign-scale compliance machinery belongs to call-center platforms.

### Inbound is secondary

Prospects calling back is expected and handled — ring surfaces, missed-call queues, and in some products callback routing toward the rep who dialed last — but inbound handling never becomes the organizing structure of the product. When it does, the product has moved into contact-center territory.
definition.rules_zh:
### 记录决定拨号内容

自动拨号基于记录中存储的电话号码；在许多产品中，手动变通以拨打次要号码或重复尝试是受限的。因此，记录绑定也是对呼叫本身的约束。

### 处置结果关闭呼叫

在结果被分类之前，呼叫不算“完成”。处置结果用于报告、过滤和后续生成；某些产品在保存后续处置结果前要求设置后续日期。呼叫结果是销售工作流中过滤最频繁的数据之一。

### 日志记录是自动且近乎即时的

系统在呼叫发生时记录日志；销售人员的工作是对话和分类，而非数据录入。手动日志记录作为在系统外发起呼叫的后备方案存在——这是一种有意的承认，即即使呼叫未通过拨号器进行，记录存储也必须反映现实。

### 主叫身份是运营问题，而非设置项

出站触达取决于使用的号码：展示本地或已识别的号码、轮换或监控号码以及补救垃圾邮件误标是持续性的运营工作，产品会将其呈现给用户。主叫 ID 验证策略和垃圾邮件标签保护是机制的标准组成部分。

### 合规行为以轻量级深度内置

合规功能以比呼叫中心系统更轻的形式出现：某些产品将号码与请勿打扰注册表和内部抑制列表进行核对，某些产品将呼叫限制在定义的时间窗口内，录音同意通过具有司法管辖敏感性的默认设置处理（录音通常可以在通话中途暂停）。自动团队规模拨号模式通常包括放弃处理，例如播放录音消息
